Definition: thus (only in the formula 'and so forth')
BiblicalUsage: Ke-eneth means thus, and so forth, the clerk's way of closing a list. Ezra 4:10 ends the roll of nations with and at such a time, and Ezra 4:11 opens the copy of the letter the same way.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even the driest clerk's phrase matters, because it sits in a letter God used to test his people's resolve.
